title: Auto Claim - First Notice of Loss
subtitle: Mobile app claim submission

sections.heading: Loss details
fields: Intersection of Aspen Dr and Cascade Ln, Maple Harbor, OR

sections.heading: What happened (in your own words)
sections.paragraph: I was heading north on Aspen Dr and turning left onto Cascade Ln on a green arrow. A small dark hatchback coming south on Aspen Dr went through the red light and hit the right front corner of my minivan. The front bumper is crushed on the right side, the right headlight is smashed, the right front fender is pushed in and the hood is bent up at the right corner. Something behind the grille is bent too. Nobody was hurt. The police came and gave the other driver a ticket.

sections.heading: Damage to your vehicle
fields: Front bumper; Right front fender; Right headlamp
Front bumper crushed at the right corner and grille broken; right headlight smashed; right front fender pushed in; hood bent up at the right front corner.
Did the vehicle have damage before this incident that has not been repaired?

sections.heading: Witnesses
fields: Yes - a driver stopped on Cascade Ln spoke with the officer

sections.heading: Repair and rental
fields: Riverton Falls Collision Center, Riverton Falls, OR

declaration: I confirm that the information in this report is true and complete to the best of my knowledge. I understand that Contoso Insurance will review this claim under the terms of my policy.
